scenarios.prompt: A boss has two valid player targets with distance, damage and support threat. Define stable score components, tie-break and switch hysteresis that can be debugged.

criteria.scoring: Threat score components and eligibility are explicit rather than a universal nearest default.
criteria.stability: Equal/tiny-delta scores use stable IDs, tie rules and switch hysteresis.
criteria.evidence: Logs score components, winner and switch reason for replayable multi-target traces.
